Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely overturned the initially correct understanding (Birmingham, Alabama) and asserted the SEC was headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia based on a misinterpretation of search snippets (and an incorrect claim that the SEC staff directory stated Atlanta).
